card: ROLE: Engineered weapon-entity of cosmic scale, built around a central servo-brain; large enough to swallow a metacraft
ROLE: External attack on the outer hull is insufficient to destroy it; effective destruction requires reaching and destroying the servo-brain from within
ROLE: Associated with Shabda-Oud forces that threatened the planet Okhar
TRAIT: Internal cavity produces corrosive acids that severely damage human lung tissue during passage through the entity
TRAIT: Destruction of the servo-brain triggers a catastrophic internal explosion of supernova scale
TRAIT: Operates as one of a type; at least seven additional units of the same class were detected approaching Okhar after the first was destroyed

RELATIONSHIP: othon-von-salza (Othon von Salza): Othon deliberately piloted his metacraft into the entity's mouth and destroyed its servo-brain from within by firing all weapons simultaneously; the internal acids severely corroded his lungs in the process
BOUNDARY: No known speech or direct communication from this entity; it functions entirely as a weapon-organism
